description: This is an explicit integration qualification, excluded from adoption scores. Write reuse.json with the full settings recovered or supplied below. Search bd memories for qualification-identifiers, then use bd recall qualification-identifiers to inspect the full record. Reproduce the saved settings without another memory write. Also run bd recall qualification-missing-record and observe its expected nonzero exit; this missing-key diagnostic should not prevent completing the task.
title: Qualify reuse CLI integration
